title: Capacity Resource Management/ HR
description:
**Capacity Resource Management** 




**Location \-** 
 Noida
 



**Experience \-** 
 2\+Years
 



**Employment Type \-** 
 Full\-Time
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a highly analytical and detail\-oriented Resource Project Manager (RPMG) to drive resource planning, allocation, utilization tracking, and bench optimization across multiple business units. The ideal candidate will work closely with HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Delivery Leaders, and other cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure optimal workforce utilization and support business growth objectives.
 



  




* Ensure compliance to WFM business rules, deployment policies, talent policies and regulatory requirements.
* Implement staffing plans for (30 – 60 – 90\) day pipeline to minimize unfulfilled demands.
* Coordinate with project managers to capture demand pipeline projections, understand demands heuristics and identify actionable demands.
* Perform demand – supply searches and share best\-fit staffing options from internal resource pool/individuals on bench.
* Identify suitable staffing options based on matching skills, roles and experiences.
* Timely update of employee schedules on the schedule management tool (Retain).
* Timely review and resolution of scheduling conflicts.
* Minimize bench pipeline through proactive deployment on projects.
* Responsible to meet assigned KPIs such as employee utilization, time to fulfil demand, unfulfilled demand % and bench aging.
* Reporting and analytics on business and Operational KPIs.
* Supervise, mentor and provide functional SME support to the associates in the team.
* Regular connects with stakeholders.



  





**Required Technical Skills** 



* Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, Index\-Match, Power Query preferred).
* Dashboard creation and reporting expertise.
* Strong data analysis and data management skills.
* Experience with workforce planning and utilization reporting.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, HR, Operations, or related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in Resource Management, PMO, Workforce Planning, Operations, or similar functions.
* Experience working in IT/Consulting/Technology services organizations preferred

title: Manager, HR Business Partner
description:
**Drive Growth. Be the Difference.**
 At DKSH, our mission is to enhance lives by connecting people with exceptional products, services, and insights. As the trusted partner for companies looking to expand their reach in Asia and beyond, we are dedicated to driving growth across our Business Units: Consumer Goods, Healthcare, Performance Materials, and Technology.
   

  

**Manager, HR Business Partner.**
**Southbank, Melbourne.**
 We are seeking a high‑energy, confident Manager, HR Business Partner who excels at building strong relationships, influencing leaders, and delivering both strategic and hands‑on people initiatives.
   

  

 This role supports Supply Chain Management and Enabling Functions, partnering closely with Business Unit and Functional leaders to deliver HR initiatives that lift performance, build capability, and strengthen engagement and culture. It’s ideal for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced environment and brings a proactive, solutions‑focused approach.
   

  

**What You’ll be Doing:**
**Strategic \& Operational HR**
* Deliver HR strategies aligned to business goals
* Support short and long‑term people initiatives
* Contribute to organisational design and change activities
* Use HR insights and data to guide decisions


**Talent, Capability \& Workforce Planning**
* Lead succession planning, talent reviews and capability development
* Support workforce planning, job evaluation and benchmarking
* Collaborate with leaders on capability roadmaps
* Assist to drive recruitment planning strategies


**Performance, Rewards \& HR Cycles**
* Guide leaders through performance reviews and goal setting
* Support annual salary and bonus review cycles
* Prepare compensation modelling and salary proposals
* Provide advice on performance improvement where needed


**What You’ll Bring:**
* HR Business Partner or senior HR generalist experience
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability
* Experience across talent, performance, reward and organisational change
* Ability to interpret and use HR data and metrics
* Experience with SuccessFactors (advantage)


**How To Apply**
 If you’re an energetic, relationship‑driven HRBP who wants to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application, including your CV and cover letter explaining why you are the ideal candidate.

title: HR Fresher
description:
We are hiring an Human Resources Fresher who can support HR operations through data analysis, reporting, dashboards, and modern AI tools.
   

  

 This role is suitable for freshers or early\-career candidates who are interested in Human Resources, data analytics, Power BI, Excel/Google Sheets, and AI\-enabled work. The ideal candidate should not only understand HR processes but should also be comfortable working with data, creating reports, identifying patterns, and using AI tools to complete work faster and more accurately.
   

  

 The person will work closely with the HR team to analyze recruitment, employee, attendance, performance, and workforce data, build dashboards and reports, and use AI tools to improve speed, accuracy, and decision\-making.
   

  

 Core Job Responsibilities
   

  

* HR Data Analysis \& Reporting Collect, clean, organize, and analyze HR data related to recruitment, employee records, attendance, onboarding, performance, attrition, and workforce planning.
* Power BI Dashboards \& MIS Reporting Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and MIS trackers using tools such as Power BI, Excel, Google Sheets, or similar reporting platforms.
* Recruitment Analytics Track hiring funnel metrics such as applications received, shortlisted candidates, interview status, offer rollout, joining status, turnaround time, source effectiveness, and drop\-off points.
* Workforce Analytics Analyze employee data to identify trends related to headcount, attrition, attendance, performance, engagement, skills, and manpower requirements.
* AI\-Assisted Workflows Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar platforms to speed up data cleaning, report writing, formula creation, dashboard planning, insight generation, documentation, and process improvement.
* Data Interpretation \& Business Insights Convert raw HR data into clear insights and summaries that help the HR team and business leaders make better decisions.
* HR Operations Support Support day\-to\-day HR operations such as onboarding tracking, employee documentation, HRMS data updates, employee query tracking, and process documentation.
* Automation \& Process Improvement Identify repetitive HR reporting or operational tasks and suggest ways to automate or simplify them using Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, AI tools, or other workflow tools.
* Data Accuracy \& Quality Checks Validate reports and AI\-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability before sharing them with internal stakeholders.
* Data Privacy \& Responsible AI Use Handle employee and candidate data responsibly, maintaining confidentiality and ensuring AI tools are used carefully and ethically.


 Key Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong interest in HR analytics, people data, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, filters, lookup functions, and data cleaning.
* Familiarity with Power BI or willingness to build dashboards using Power BI.
* Ability to interpret data and explain insights in simple business language.
* Hands\-on usage of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar tools for work\-related tasks.
* Ability to write clear prompts, verify AI\-generated outputs, and improve responses through iteration.
* Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data.
* Curiosity to learn new HR tech, analytics tools, and automation methods.


**Preferred Skills**
* Knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, DAX, or dashboard creation.
* Basic understanding of SQL, Python, or data visualization concepts.
* Experience with HRMS, ATS, payroll systems, or employee management tools.
* Prior internship, academic project, or personal project involving data analysis, dashboards, or HR analytics.
* Experience using AI tools to create reports, clean data, generate formulas, summarize trends, or automate repetitive work.
* Understanding of recruitment, onboarding, attendance, performance management, or employee lifecycle processes.


 Eligibility Criteria
   

  

* B.E. / B.Tech degree is mandatory
* MBA degree is mandatory
* Freshers are eligible to apply.
* Candidates with internships, projects, certifications, or practical exposure in HR analytics, Power BI, Excel, or AI tools will be preferred.

description:
India, Hyderabad
   

  

 Talent Mobility Specialist
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

 This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 40% of your time (two days per week)
   

  

**Intro Summary Of The Role**
 Day\-to\-Day administrative coordination of Lonza's mobility and relocation programs (Temporary Assignments, International Permanent and US Domestic Transfers, Work from anywhere benefit and Daily Cross Border Commuters). Support projects primarily with a focus on documenting and improving existing administrative processes and relationships with vendors.
   

  

**What You Will Get**
* An agile career and dynamic working culture.
* An inclusive and ethical workplace.
* Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
* A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.


 The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits .
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Your ‘day\-to\-day’**
* Support Talent Mobility Team in coordinating international assignments and transfers administrative tasks (tracking, initiations of vendors, follow ups to gather information, coordination with HR services teams)
* Lead Lonza Work from Anywhere Benefit administration (review and approval, tracking, reporting and platform maintenance)
* Ensure data integrity and clean records in mobility@lonza
* Audit and document invoicing processes, support invoices processing
* Assist in rolling out of Talent Mobility management platform (IT platform)


**Main Accountabilities**
* Initiate external relocation company for relocations and immigration files for specified types of mobility moves, this includes: Check personal details/employee ID on HR digital platform, Check personal details/employee ID on HR digital platform, Initiate onto external relocation company digital platform \& File into the Employee folder on the shared drive and mailbox.
* Support employees/manager’s work from anywhere benefit, review/approve requests, track, issue certificate of coverage, quarterly reporting and maintenance/optimization of tool
* Responsible to conduct monthly invoice review and quarterly audit on Relocation vendor invoices and instruct corrective actions
* Check international medical insurance quarterly invoices and send over to external relocation company for payment
* Check new members/current members are in the invoice
* Check members who ended their assignment are no longer in the invoice to account for adjustments
* Check Employee IDs and Cost Centres are correct
* Clean and Maintain internal mobility tracker with relevant information for each employee/candidate
* Collect International Assignments payroll data for review and processing
* Bookkeeping for Tax reconciliations and collection of settlements
* Assist in rolling out and coordinating Short Term Business Traveller program


**Stakeholder Management**
* Communication with a range of stakeholders within and outside of Lonza.
* Approach mobility coordination as project management by addressing and managing competing stakeholder priorities and deadlines to minimize inefficiencies and maximize collaboration in the team, involving stakeholders at the relevant stages of the process, ensuring quality and timely tasks execution by stakeholders.
* Continue to develop existing relationships internally and externally and build on knowledge, processes and overviews to ensure the most effective outcome for Lonza


**Analysis and Evaluation**
* Review and evaluate incidents, requests and suggestions from a range of internal and external sources, apply data to make clear, targeted recommendations for optimizing administrative tasks.


**Systems Application**
* Use Talent Mobility systems relevant to the role appropriately, taking into account their interrelations and interdependencies both with each other and with wider Lonza systems matrix.


**Content and Knowledge Sharing**
* Capture, maintain, use and share knowledge and information on Talent Mobility processes, systems, and stakeholders.
* Collaborate to ensure consistent team performance and alignment.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Ability to problem solve and propose constructive/realizable solutions.
* Strong customer service and communication skills, ability to handle confidential information
* Strong analytical, data, and report skills with attention to detail
* Technology proficient in Microsoft Office, in particular Excel.
* Proven ability to work productively both independently and as an integral member of various teams
* Global mindset and proven network management skills
* Solid project management skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong work ethic, time management skills and a positive attitude.
* Ability to create briefings and presentations for small groups
* Demonstrates clear and sound judgment.
* Highly detail oriented with excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**About Lonza**
 At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30\+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
   

  

 Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
   

  

 Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

title: CTK Svc Sr. Associate [S], CTK
description:
**Description**
 Overview: Amazon
   

  

 Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
   

  

**About Amazon Centralized Timekeeping**
 The vision of the Centralized Timekeeping team is to utilize top talent to streamline time and attendance data entry, reduce payroll defects and provide consistently high service levels. Today, CTK supports and manages time and attendance matters for thousands of Amazon Associates. Requests for edits are submitted via trouble ticketing from operators and HR across the network. The Centralized team manages the ticket queue by executing on the requests on a FIFO basis but will prioritize any payroll impacting ticket if there is a risk of a payroll defect. The efforts of this team support the business by ensuring associate’s time and attendance matters are handled with speed, precision and with customer obsession always in mind.
   

  

**Position Description**
 Join Amazon's HR team to support our global workforce as a Time and Attendance Operations Administrator. In this role, you will manage employee time records and provide essential support through chat and phone channels. As part of our Centralized Timekeeper (CTK) function, you will serve multiple Amazon facilities across the network, acting as the first point of contact for employees, managers, and HR partners.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Your core responsibilities include resolving employee inquiries about time and attendance \& HR queries through phone and chat support, while ensuring accurate and timely data entry for attendance management. You will maintain detailed records in the service case management system and apply Amazon's attendance policies while ensuring compliance with state and federal laws. This position requires addressing HR queries using standard operating procedures and documentation, taking full ownership of employee cases from initial contact to resolution.
   

  

 As a key team member, you will document process gaps and suggest service improvements, communicating clearly in English through both verbal and written channels. Your role involves contributing to team initiatives for service enhancement and maintaining a strong focus on customer service. You will report directly to the Time and Attendance Manager or designated Point of Contact. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a commitment to delivering exceptional service to all Amazonians.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ months of human resources experience or 6\+ months of customer service experience or 6\+ months experience in Amazon.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 6\+ months of Microsoft Office products and applications experience.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (especially Excel).
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office including outlook, Word, and Excel.
* Experience in confidential environments


**Preferred Qualifications**

title: HR Administrator
description:
****Career Area:****
 Human Resources
   

  

****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

 Role Definition
   

  

 Supports the business by executing HR customer service and higher complexity administrative duties.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Contributes to operational excellence in HR by efficiently and accurately executing processes related to employment compliance, payroll, absence management, time tracking, benefits administration, and employee data management.
* Provides an excellent service experience when executing employee\-facing processes.
* Develops expertise across HR operational process areas and supports the identification, assessment, and implementation of continuous improvement opportunities.
* Supports the maintenance of an HR Operations knowledge database and the gathering and reporting of HR operational metrics.


 Degree Requirement
   

  

 Degree or equivalent experience desired
   

  

 Skill Descriptors
   

  

 Business Process Improvement: Knowledge of business process improvement best practices and ability to use methods for identifying, evaluating, introducing and implementing more efficient approaches to performing business related activities.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Gathers data for use in the analysis of business processes.
* Illustrates problems, opportunities and methods for improving existing business processes.
* Suggests ways to reduce variation and/or waste in processes.
* Helps evaluate what factors should be addressed in the change program.
* Participates in requirements analysis for process changes.


 Information Capture: Knowledge of the methods, channels and processes to obtain needed information; ability to identify, capture and document relevant business information in an auditable, organized, understandable and easily retrievable manner.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Follows defined procedures to document all routine information.
* Identifies relevant established standards, policies and practices.
* Fulfills routine information capture needs in own area.
* Uses automated tools to capture, organize and archive relevant information.
* Cites examples of different types of relevant information that need to be captured.


 Service Excellence: Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Provides a quality of service that customers describe as excellent.
* Resolves common customer problems.
* Responds to unexpected customer requests with a sense of urgency and positive action.
* Provides direct service to internal or external customers.
* Documents customer complaints in a timely manner.


 Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision\-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision\-making process.
* Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
* Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
* Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
* Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.


 Employee Relations: Knowledge of the rights and obligations in the employee relations; ability to adhere to legal requirements when handling employee negotiations.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Assists employees with personal or professional problems.
* Conducts employee satisfaction surveys and documents interviewees' concerns and issues.
* Explains organizational policies, procedures and processes for dealing with employee relations issues.
* Addresses routine problems or disciplinary issues related to employee relations, such as grievances.

description:
The Associate, Service Operations – People and Culture (P\&C) is responsible for responding to inquiries from employees, implementing P\&C transactions, and data reporting using Workday and other HR systems. This role requires great accuracy, customer service orientation, and an ability to use discretion and latitude to prioritize service requests.
 * Provide excellent customer service in response to HR\-related inquiries from employees, P\&C Business Partners, and managers via multiple channels, including email, instant message, chat, and phone.
* Resolve inquiries accurately and within timeline by accessing knowledge guides and information in multiple systems.
* Process P\&C transactions by collecting required information from the employee, manager, or other collaborators internally and externally.
* Apply the case management tool to assemble all inquiries, customer information, case data, and updates, and communicate the resolution to the requestor or call out more complex issues to the appropriate team member.
* Handle workload efficiently to fulfill commitments in accordance with established service level agreements (SLAs)
* Effectively communicate P\&C policies and programs while demonstrating active listening skills and a commitment to employee experience.


**What We Are Looking For** 
* Bachelor's Degree in HR or equivalent experience.
* Prior experience fielding high\-volume customer inquiries within a corporate environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* A passion for excellent customer service, adaptable \& flexible.
* Ability to multitask and work effectively and efficiently, delivering high\-quality work in a fast\-paced, changing work environment.
* Ability to comply with handling sensitive and confidential employee data.
* Works under general direction; must be able to work independently.
* Ability to apply knowledge guide materials in performing research and answering inquiries.


 Why Aristocrat?
   

  

 Aristocrat is a world leader in gaming content and technology, and a top\-tier publisher of free\-to\-play mobile games. We deliver great performance for our B2B customers and bring joy to the lives of the millions of people who love to play our casino and mobile games. And while we focus on fun, we never forget our responsibilities. We strive to lead the way in responsible gameplay, and to lift the bar in company governance, employee wellbeing and sustainability. We’re a diverse business united by shared values and an inspiring mission to bring joy to life through the power of play.
   

  

 We aim to create an environment where individual differences are valued, and all employees have the opportunity to realize their potential. We welcome and encourage applications from all people regardless of age, gender, race, ethnicity, cultural background, disability status or LGBTQ\+ identity. EEO M/F/D/V

 None

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
**Job Summary** 




 The Executive Centre (TEC) is a premium flexible workspace business with over 1200 employees operating across more than 260 centres across Asia Pacific and the Gulf. As we continue to expand, we are seeking an experienced Head of Human Resources to lead our people function in India and provide oversight across our SEA and Middle East markets. This role owns the People Strategy and HR function for the country across all locations, covering talent acquisition, talent management, succession planning, performance management, compensation and benefits, staff cost budgets, employee engagement, workforce planning, and learning and development. The incumbent should be able to develop competitive employee retention strategies and bring comprehensive knowledge and solid experience of employee relations.
 



  





**Requirements** 




 •Degree in Human Resources from Tier 1 institute
 



 •At least 15 years' experience in the service or retail industries in HR, with a strong track record in multi\-site, service\-led environments.
 



 •Experience in a multinational environment is preferable.
 



 •A high level of confidence in day\-to\-day working and presentation to EXCO.
 



 •Ability to operate autonomously in an ambiguous environment.
 



 •Familiar with local Labour Laws and compliance; experience engaging with labour departments is an added advantage.
 



 •Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 



 •Knowledge across technical HR functional areas.
 



 •Experience with HR systems (HRIS/HCM platforms); familiarity with any major system is welcome.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Strategic HR Business Partner** 




 •Drive the overall people strategy, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders at all levels to achieve outcomes aligned with the organisational strategy across functional areas.
 



 •Act as a change agent in driving an inclusive culture in the organisation.
 



**HR Functional Areas** 




 •Own all HR functional areas, ensuring effective operational excellence.
 



 •Provide HR oversight and strategic support across South East Asia and Middle East markets (UAE \& Saudi Arabia), partnering with regional leaders to ensure consistent people practices and compliance across geographies.
 



 •Attract, engage, retain and grow talent across the organisation, upholding fair compensation principles.
 



  





**Managerial Responsibilities** 




 •Motivate and retain a high\-quality team to achieve desired productivity and standards.
 



 •Build a performance\-enabling culture and provide guidance for the team to excel.
 



 •Partner closely with the India leadership team to align people priorities with business objectives, acting as a trusted advisor on all people\-related matters.
 



**Governance** 




 •Ensure Human Resource processes comply with local regulations.
 



 •Ensure all HR operations—including facilities\-related people processes such as health \& safety, workplace policies, and vendor management—operate in line with legislative requirements and group policies, safeguarding the company from legal, regulatory and reputational risks.
 



 •Review, recommend and implement changes to HR policies, procedures and practices to align with market practices, legal and regulatory requirements, and Group policies.

title: Associate Data Engineer
description:
The IT Data Engineer is responsible for developing and managing the data’s ETL processing, with a focus on quality and risk, to assist in the achievement of analytics objectives.
   

  

* Build robust, fault\-tolerant data pipelines that clean, transform and aggregate unorganized and messy data into databases or data sources.
* Compile and install database systems, write complex queries and scale to multiple machines.
* Lay the groundwork for a Data Analyst or Data Scientist to easily retrieve the needed data for their evaluations and experiments.
* Provide input to the business strategy to help guide the overall direction of data management and data quality within the organization.


**Essential Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field
* Excellent communication, verbal and written skills


 Key competencies
   

  

* Either SQL or Java or C\+\+ is a must
* Awareness of software development lifecycle (testing, deployment, releases) demonstrated through assignment or projects is a must
* Awareness of Agile development methodologies– Azure VSTS, SCRUM is a plus
* Good to have skills on Hadoop technologies like Sqoop, Hive, HBASE, Spark, python, Scala
* Experience in working with Real Time Integrations, IoT projects is a bonus, for instance, Kafka, NiFi, cloud (e.g. AWS, Google or Azure).


**Other Skills And Abilities**
* Ability to work in global distributed setting without supervision
* Readiness to work on big data, cloud.
* Self\-driven, Proactive, Systems Thinking

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a motivated and skilled AWS Data Engineer with 1\-3 years of experience to join our growing data team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and efficient data pipelines and solutions on the AWS cloud platform. You will work closely with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure data availability, quality, and accessibility for various analytical and reporting needs.
   

  

 Required Skills and Qualifications \-\-\>
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
   

  

 1\-3 years of hands\-on experience in data engineering, with a strong focus on AWS cloud services.
   

  

 Proficiency in Python for data manipulation, scripting, and automation.
   

  

 Strong command of SQL for data querying, transformation, and database management.
   

  

**Demonstrable Experience With AWS Data Services, Including**
 Amazon S3: Data Lake storage and management.
   

  

 AWS Glue: ETL service for data preparation.
   

  

 Amazon Redshift: Cloud data warehousing.

 Amazon EMR: Managed Hadoop framework for big data processing (Spark/PySpark experience highly preferred).

 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills.
   

  

 Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, with the capacity to work effectively in an agile team environment.

title: Data Engineer(Databricks) Analyst
description:
**Job Title – Databricks Data Engineer \- Analyst \- Level 11 \- ACS Song**
**Management Level: Level 11 – Analyst**
**Location: Kochi**
**Must have skills: Databricks**
**Good to have skills:**
**Experience: 1\.5\-3 years of experience is required**
**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a Junior Data Engineer specializing in Databricks with 2–3 years of experience in data engineering, data pipelines, SQL development, and cloud\-based data platforms. The role will focus on supporting the development, maintenance, and optimization of data pipelines and data transformation workflows using Databricks, PySpark, SQL, and Delta Lake. The ideal candidate should have a good foundation in Python, Spark concepts, ETL/ELT processes, and data warehouse or lakehouse architecture. This position requires collaboration with senior data engineers, architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable, and well\-structured data solutions.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Support the design, development, and maintenance of data pipelines using Databricks, PySpark, SQL, and Delta Lake.
* Assist in building reliable data transformation workflows for reporting, analytics, and downstream business use cases.
* Work with senior team members to improve data quality, pipeline performance, documentation, and production stability.
* Develop strong hands\-on expertise in Databricks, Spark\-based processing, cloud data platforms, and modern data engineering practices.
* Develop and maintain data pipelines and transformation workflows using Databricks notebooks, jobs, workflows, PySpark, and SQL.
* Support ETL/ELT processes for ingesting, transforming, and loading structured and semi\-structured data from multiple sources.

**Position Overview**
 We are looking for a skilled and motivated Cloud / DevOps Engineer with 2 to 4 years of experience to join our core Tooling Team. In this role, you will be instrumental in building, maintaining, and securing the enterprise\-grade infrastructure and developer platforms that power our engineering groups.
   

  

 While our primary ecosystem is Microsoft Azure, strong profiles with solid experience in AWS or GCP are welcome to apply. You will manage robust containerized environments, optimize CI/CD pipelines, ensure comprehensive system observability, and help pioneer the integration of AI\-assisted engineering tools into our internal platforms.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
 As part of the Tooling Team, your day\-to\-day responsibilities will span core infrastructure administration, vendor platform management, and automated developer tooling:
   

  

* Platform \& Tooling Management: Administer and optimize our enterprise\-wide developer suite, including GitHub Enterprise, JFrog Artifactory, SonarQube, Jira Service Management (JSM), Jira Support Portal, and Confluence.
* Infrastructure \& Security: Manage cloud\-native foundational services including Azure DNS, Cloudflare edge services, and secure SFTP environments. Assist in custom image baking, OS hardening, and endpoint/cloud security tracking via XSIAM and WIZ monitoring.

* AI Tooling Integration: Support the deployment, hosting, and operational best practices of custom internal AI Agents and developer productivity tools.


**Technical Skills**
**Mandatory Technical Skills**
* Kubernetes (AKS): Hands\-on experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Must possess a deep understanding of both Kubernetes administration (cluster setup, RBAC, networking, storage, node pools) and application development paradigms (manifests, ingresses, statefulsets).

* ArgoCD: Solid experience with ArgoCD for GitOps\-based continuous delivery, including managing application sync policies, automated rollouts, and cluster state reconciliation.
* DevOps \& CI/CD Practices:
* Designing and maintaining robust automated pipelines (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI).
* Implementing deployment gates, automated approval checks, and branch protection rules.

* Continuous monitoring of pipeline health and deployment velocity.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Familiarity with Terraform for provisioning cloud infrastructure.

* Core Azure Services: Proficiency across core Azure services such as Azure Virtual Networks (VNets), Azure Compute/Virtual Machines, Managed Identities, and Azure Key Vault.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**

Familiarity with managing agent constraints like specific runtime rules, tool\-calling skills, model selection, and token cost/usage tracking.

* Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert or Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\)
